learnings.problem: Ordinary-size Search and empty-state text passed earlier visual review below 4.5:1.
learnings.resolution: Treat computed foreground/background contrast for every normal, hover and focus state as an atomic readability check; Attempt18 QA measured Search at 4.874435:1 after correction.
learnings.landing: roles/blind-qa-tpp.md and strict visual QA checklist candidate

learnings.problem: A child region could overflow while a parent clip made the whole page appear free of horizontal overflow.
learnings.resolution: Probe both document/phone widths and the bounding/scroll geometry of each declared inner organism; parent overflow masking is not proof that inner geometry fits.

learnings.problem: A stale goal-contract.json coexisted with the sealed v2 correction and caused canonical protocol consumers to resolve different goals.
learnings.resolution: Resolve the canonical sealed goal by the goalId already bound by Brand Intent, then bind every QA artifact to its freshly computed hash.

learnings.problem: apply-host spent about one hour repeating brand and host work while the QDMP simulator served a stale process-level preview session.
learnings.resolution: Separate disk build proof from runtime delivery proof. Probe the current simulator manifest, fail within seconds on an unmounted output directory, route the defect to the developer-tool layer, and require a same-process reopen regression before closure.
learnings.landing: qdmp-preview-handshake runtime gate and QDMP preview reliability runbook

decisions.problem: Focus indicator has no visible outline or shadow.
decisions.resolution: Keep as an explicit warning because Attempt18 contrast and reversible behavior pass but the frozen goal contains no focus-appearance threshold.

decisions.problem: A developer-tool failure looked like an apply-host implementation failure.
decisions.resolution: Treat runtime manifest delivery as a platform boundary. A platform blocker pauses preview QA but never invalidates frozen brand evidence or restarts learn-brand.

ruleCandidates.problem: Legacy and current composition contracts encode the same frozen asset/layer facts differently.
ruleCandidates.resolution: Normalize assetIdentity@sha and string layer names into the strict current structure before validation; still require identity, variant, at least two layers, and exact layer matching.
